appName.message: Tab Mission: ogni scheda a portata di tasto

lang.description: BCP 47 language tag of this translation, set as the pages' lang attribute.

appDescription.message: Il tuo centro di comando per le schede. Panoramica istantanea, cambio fulmineo, ricerca immediata.
appDescription.description: Store summary and manifest description (max 132 characters).

actionTitle.description: Toolbar button tooltip; also the welcome page's open button.

commandOpen.message: Apri Tab Mission o passa alla scheda selezionata
commandOpen.description: Description of the main keyboard shortcut on chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

commandOpenSite.message: Apri Tab Mission solo con le schede del sito corrente o passa alla scheda selezionata
commandOpenSite.description: Description of the site-view keyboard shortcut.

pageTitle.description: The title of the extension's main HTML page.

searchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text for the search input field.

searchLabel.description: Accessible name of the search box (the placeholder says what can be searched).

shortcutHintLabel.description: Read by screen readers only, before the shortcut shown in the toolbar badge.

showAllWindowsLabel.description: Label for the 'Show all windows' checkbox.

resetWindowTitle.description: Tooltip for the button that resets the window size and position.

gridLabel.description: Accessible name of the tab grid.

emptyNoTabs.description: Shown when no tabs could be read.

emptyNoMatch.description: Shown when the search or filters match nothing.

untitled.description: Fallback title for a tab without one.

sleepingBadge.description: Badge on tabs Chrome has put to sleep.

closeTabTitle.description: Tooltip of the close control on a tile. Shift+Delete closes the selected card from the keyboard; name the keys as keyboards label them in this language.

tabClosed.description: Tab Mission window: said to screen readers once a card's tab is closed (×, middle-click or Shift+Delete).

siteScopeClear.description: Button that leaves the site view.

shortcutNotSet.description: Settings page: shown instead of the keys of a shortcut that is not set.

shortcutChange.description: Settings page: button next to an assigned shortcut; opens Chrome's shortcuts page in a new tab.

shortcutSet.description: Settings page: button next to a shortcut that is not set; opens Chrome's shortcuts page in a new tab.

welcomeNoShortcut.message: Chrome non ha potuto assegnare la scorciatoia predefinita, probabilmente perché un'altra estensione la usa già. Scegline una per aprire Tab Mission dalla tastiera.
welcomeNoShortcut.description: Welcome page: the default shortcut could not be assigned.

welcomeSetShortcut.description: Welcome page button that opens chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

welcomeTryTitle.description: Welcome page: heading of the checklist the user completes by doing each step.

welcomeStepOpen.message: Premi $shortcut$ in qualsiasi pagina per aprire Tab Mission.
welcomeStepOpen.description: Welcome page checklist, step 1. Ticks when a Tab Mission keyboard shortcut is pressed (not the toolbar button).

welcomeStepOpenUnset.message: Scegli una scorciatoia, poi premila per aprire Tab Mission.
welcomeStepOpenUnset.description: Welcome page checklist, step 1, when Chrome could not assign a shortcut.

welcomeStepBack.message: Premi di nuovo la scorciatoia per tornare alla scheda precedente.
welcomeStepBack.description: Welcome page checklist, step 2: the shortcut pressed in the open Tab Mission window switches to the previous tab.

welcomeStepPoint.message: Punta il mouse su un riquadro e premi $shortcut$ per andare a quella scheda.
welcomeStepPoint.description: Welcome page checklist, step 3: in the Tab Mission window, the shortcut pressed with the pointer on a card switches to that card's tab.

welcomeStepPointUnset.message: Punta il mouse su un riquadro e premi la scorciatoia per andare a quella scheda.
welcomeStepPointUnset.description: Welcome page checklist, step 3, when Chrome could not assign a shortcut.

welcomeStepDone.description: Welcome page checklist: shown beside a step that is done.

welcomeStepTodo.description: Welcome page checklist: the state of a step not done yet (read by screen readers only).

welcomeStepAnnounce.description: Welcome page checklist: announced to screen readers when a step ticks.

step.example: Press ⌘E on any page to open Tab Mission.

welcomeAllSet.description: Welcome page checklist: shown once all three steps are done.

welcomeTipsTitle.description: Welcome page: heading of the tips under the checklist.

welcomeTipSearch.message: Digita qualche lettera per trovare una scheda, poi premi di nuovo la scorciatoia per passarci.
welcomeTipSearch.description: Welcome page: the first of the extra tips.

welcomeTipSite.message: Quando Tab Mission mostra almeno due schede del sito in cui sei, premi $shortcut$ nella casella di ricerca per vedere solo quelle.
welcomeTipSite.description: Welcome page tip about the site scope (Tab in the search box).

welcomeTipClose.message: In Tab Mission, fai clic con il tasto centrale su un riquadro, o sulla sua ×, per chiudere quella scheda.

welcomePin.message: Suggerimento: fissa Tab Mission alla barra degli strumenti (icona del puzzle, poi la puntina) per aprirlo con un clic.
welcomePin.description: Welcome page tip shown when the toolbar button is not pinned.

welcomePrivacy.message: Tab Mission non ha server: l'elenco delle tue schede, le tue ricerche e le immagini delle pagine restano nel browser.

optionOpenHeading.description: Settings page: heading of the section on how Tab Mission opens and shows the tabs.

optionSaved.description: Settings page: announced to screen readers after a setting is saved (not shown).

settingsTitle.description: Tooltip of the gear button that opens the settings page.

optionPreselect.description: Settings page: label of the pre-select switch.

optionPreselectNote.message: Premi due volte la scorciatoia per tornarci. Se disattivata, nessuna scheda è selezionata e la seconda pressione chiude Tab Mission.
optionPreselectNote.description: Settings page: one line under the pre-select switch.

optionGroupBySite.description: Settings page, shown with Classic mode: label of the switch that groups the tabs by site.

optionGroupBySiteNote.message: Prima le cinque schede più recenti, poi un pannello per ogni sito con almeno due schede, poi le altre.
optionGroupBySiteNote.description: Settings page: one line under the group-by-site switch.

optionLookHeading.description: Settings page: heading of the appearance section.

optionAppearance.description: Settings page: label of the light or dark choice.

optionAppearanceNote.message: Segue il sistema, a meno che tu non ne scelga uno qui.
optionAppearanceNote.description: Settings page: one line under the light or dark choice.

optionAppearanceSystem.description: Settings page: choice that follows the system appearance.

optionAppearanceLight.description: Settings page: choice for the light appearance.

optionAppearanceDark.description: Settings page: choice for the dark appearance.

optionBackdrop.description: Label of a setting on the settings page: what is shown behind the cards.

optionBackdropNote.message: Dietro i riquadri. Tinta unita finché non c'è ancora un'immagine della pagina, o quando il sistema chiede meno trasparenza.

optionBackdropPage.message: La pagina in cui eri, sfocata
optionBackdropPage.description: Backdrop choice, the default: a blurred picture of the page the user was on. Plain when there is no picture of it.

optionBackdropWallpaper.description: Backdrop choice: a soft gradient of colors that come with Tab Mission.

optionModeHeading.description: Settings page: heading of the section with the two modes, Art mode and Classic mode.

optionModeArt.description: Settings page: name of the default mode, on a card with a small picture of it. The cards are spread out at different sizes, like windows in Mission Control.

optionModeArtNote.message: Le schede recenti sono più grandi, tutte in vista insieme
optionModeArtNote.description: Settings page: one line under the name "Art mode", on its card.

optionModeClassic.description: Settings page: name of the other mode, on a card with a small picture of it. It is the grid of version 1, in a window of its own.

optionModeClassicNote.message: Riquadri tutti uguali, in una finestra a parte
optionModeClassicNote.description: Settings page: one line under the name "Classic mode", on its card.

optionOpenAs.description: Settings page, shown with Art mode: heading of the choice of how much Tab Mission covers.

optionOpenAsNote.message: Dove una pagina non si può coprire, o non risponde, «Solo la pagina» apre invece una finestra della stessa grandezza.
optionOpenAsNote.description: Settings page: one line under the two choices of what Art mode covers. Keep the quoted name the same as the choice "The page only".

optionOpenAsPage.description: Choice of what Art mode covers, on a card with a small picture: only the web page; the browser's tab strip and toolbar stay in view.

optionOpenAsPageNote.message: La barra delle schede resta in vista
optionOpenAsPageNote.description: Settings page: one line under the choice "The page only", on its card.

optionOpenAsWindow.description: Choice of what Art mode covers, on a card with a small picture: a window of its own that covers the whole browser window.

optionOpenAsWindowNote.description: Settings page: one line under the choice "The whole browser window", on its card.

optionPrivacyHeading.description: Settings page: heading of the section with the page pictures switch.

optionPagePictures.description: Settings page: label of the switch for the pictures of pages shown on the cards (on by default).

optionPagePicturesNote.message: I riquadri mostrano ogni pagina com'era l'ultima volta che l'hai vista. Le immagini restano su questo computer. Se disattivata, Tab Mission non ne acquisisce e cancella quelle che ha; i riquadri mostrano l'immagine di anteprima della pagina o l'icona del sito.
optionPagePicturesNote.description: Settings page: what the page pictures switch does.

optionHelpHeading.description: Settings page: heading of the help section.

optionShowTips.description: Settings page: switch for the tips in the Tab Mission window.

optionShowTipsNote.message: Ogni volta se attivata; se disattivata, solo le prime volte dopo l'installazione.
optionShowTipsNote.description: Settings page: what the Show tips switch does.

optionAboutHeading.description: Settings page: hidden heading, read by screen readers, of the closing line with the version and links.

optionVersion.description: Settings page: the version, in the closing line.

linkPrivacy.description: Settings page: link to the privacy policy.

linkReview.description: Settings page: link to Tab Mission's reviews on the Chrome Web Store.

linkFeedback.description: Settings page: link to the issue tracker.

searchSitePlaceholder.description: Search placeholder inside the site scope.

siteScopeHint.description: Hint at the right of the empty search box; Tab or click scopes to the current site.

searchAllTabs.description: Button in the empty state of the site scope; leaves the scope and keeps the query.

emptyNoMatchInSite.message: Nessuna scheda di $host$ corrisponde alla ricerca.
emptyNoMatchInSite.description: Empty state inside the site scope.

lookNotice.message: Nuovo aspetto: modalità artistica. Per la griglia di prima, scegli la modalità classica nelle Impostazioni.
lookNotice.description: Tab Mission window: shown once after the update from version 1 to version 2, pointing at the settings button. Use the names of the two modes as on the settings page ("Art mode", "Classic mode"); "the grid" is the layout of version 1.

tipBack.message: Premi di nuovo $shortcut$ per tornare qui
tipBack.description: Tab Mission window: tip pointing at the selected card (the previous tab).

tipOpen.message: Premi $shortcut$ in qualsiasi momento per aprire Tab Mission
tipOpen.description: Tab Mission window: tip pointing at the shortcut badge when it was opened with a click (the toolbar button or the welcome page's button).

tipPoint.message: Premi $shortcut$ per andare a questa scheda
tipPoint.description: Tab Mission window: tip pointing at a card the pointer has stayed on (the shortcut goes to it).

groupRecent.description: Tab Mission, grouped by site: label above the most recent tabs.

groupOther.description: Tab Mission, grouped by site: heading of the last group, the tabs not shown above it (sites with one tab, pages that are not web pages such as local files).

addressExtension.description: Tab Mission card: shown under the title, where a web page shows its site, for a page of another extension.

addressFile.description: Tab Mission card: shown under the title, where a web page shows its site, for a file opened from the computer.
